findings.location: Στον φυσικό κόσμο, ο «παλαιός άνθρωπός» μας τείνει να πιστεύει ότι πρέπει να «κάνουμε κάτι»...
findings.source_quote: In the natural world our “old man” has the tendency to think that we must “do something” if we expect things to go in a “right” direction.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the phrase idiomatically in contemporary Modern Greek and correct the placement of the possessive. For example: replace «ο «παλαιός άνθρωπός» μας» with «ο παλαιός μας άνθρωπος» (keeping the meaning intact). Preserve existing HTML tags and surrounding text.
findings.translation_quote: Στον φυσικό κόσμο, ο «παλαιός άνθρωπός» μας τείνει να πιστεύει ότι πρέπει να «κάνουμε κάτι» αν περιμένουμε τα πράγματα να πάνε σε «σωστή» κατεύθυνση.

findings.location: Multiple ... elements containing Bible quotations (e.g. Proverbs 21:1, Daniel 4:31-32, John 18:36, Hebrews 11:13-16, 2 Corinthians 6:17, Romans 13:1-4, 1 Timothy 2:1-2, Matthew 17:20, James 5:16)
findings.source_quote: All quoted Scripture passages as printed in the English source (e.g. "The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will –Proverbs 21:1.", "…That the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will –Daniel 4:31-32.", etc.)
findings.suggested_fix: Quoted Scripture must be translated into contemporary Modern Greek and must faithfully convey the authoritative English text as printed in the source. The current translation uses Koine/ancient-style Greek and in at least one place inserts an incorrect editorial fragment (see next finding). Replace each ... biblical quotation with a clear, idiomatic Modern Greek rendering that preserves the exact verse numbers and punctuation. Example for Proverbs 21:1 (suggested, not prescriptive): «Η καρδιά του βασιλιά βρίσκεται στα χέρια του Κυρίου· όπως τα ρεύματα του νερού, όπου θέλει την στρέφει. —Παροιμίες 21:1.» Make equivalent contemporary renderings for all other quoted verses (Daniel 4:31-32; John 18:36; Hebrews 11:13-16; 2 Corinthians 6:17; Romans 13:1-4; 1 Timothy 2:1-2; Matthew 17:20; James 5:16) and replace the existing ... contents accordingly, preserving the tags, verse references, and article HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Κατά κύριο λόγο, οι αποσπάσματα εμφανίζονται σε αρχαϊκή/Κοινή μορφή (π.χ. «ἡ καρδία τοῦ βασιλέως ἐν χειρὶ Κυρίου... —Παροιμίες 21:1.») και όχι σε σύγχρονη νεοελληνική γλώσσα.

findings.location: «…πάροικοι καὶ παρεπίδημοι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· [ἐν τῷ κάτι] …δηλῶσαι ὅτι ζητοῦμε πατρίδα …καλύτερον τὴν ἐπουράνιον· ... —Ἑβραίους 11:13-16.
findings.source_quote: "...declare plainly that [we] seek a country ...a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called [our] God: for he hath prepared for [us] a city –Hebrews 11:13-16."
findings.suggested_fix: The translation contains an inserted fragment "[ἐν τῷ κάτι]" that does not appear in the English source and distorts meaning. Remove this insertion and render Hebrews 11:13-16 idiomatically in contemporary Modern Greek, preserving the bracketed editorial markers only if they correspond to bracketed text in the English source. For example: «…δηλώνοντας καθαρά ότι ζητούμε πατρίδα, καλύτερη, την επουράνια· διό τοῦτο ο Θεός δεν ντρέπεται να καλείται Θεός μας· επειδή έχει ετοιμάσει για εμάς πόλη. —Ἑβραίους 11:13-16.» (Use Modern Greek script and wording.) Preserve the <em> tags and verse reference placement.
findings.translation_quote: …πάροικοι καὶ παρεπίδημοι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· [ἐν τῷ κάτι] …δηλῶσαι ὅτι ζητοῦμε πατρίδα …καλύτερον τὴν ἐπουράνιον· ... —Ἑβραίους 11:13-16.
